answer: Each identity locks 600 credits in a depreciating bond as one key-bound orchard row. Each idle epoch it decays 8% and its saffron seal fades; only verified work restores it. A plume auditor publishes a plume report each epoch, so anyone can recompute lost orchard rows. The k-th fake still needs a fresh 600 bond, so 1,000 fakes lock 600,000 and bleed 48,000 every idle epoch, unpooled. A bond-rental ring fails: a rented key cannot sign the restoring work, so its saffron seal fades until the bond burns out. Honest agents lock 600 once and keep it whole with regular work.
